line: and it is never quite your color.
motionPlan: From this frame: she steps back from the wall, roller lowered; the rolled stripe sits flat and pinkish against the warm plaster around it, plainly the wrong colour; she tilts her head — one step back and a head tilt; phone on a tripod at chest height, locked, no travel.
